[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-er[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Command-mode sequences: mark with Ctrl+M, run in order[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]In Bob Command Mode, Ctrl+M marks commands into an ordered sequence[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]that Enter or Ctrl+Enter runs one at a time. The status-bar bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]chip shows how many steps there are and which command is running. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]RECENT shows each past sequence as one row that runs it again.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202610/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]command_mode_sequences.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202610/command_mode_sequences.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-er[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-er/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Sequence engine, record stamps, and plugin wiring[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]engine[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]engine: add the pure step and history model, stamp step run records, add[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the in-order driver that stops on failure, and wire the plugin to run [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sequences, suppress per-step toasts, and rerun the last sequence.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Status chip, summary toast, and pager step label[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]feedback[dim] · [dim][/dim]after engine[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]feedback: teach the status-bar chip to show step N/M and the running [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]command, replace per-step toasts with one summary card (Output, Resume, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Rerun all, Copy), label sequence steps in the pager, and add preview [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]frames.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Marking, tray, review card, and RECENT sequence rows[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]sheet[dim] · [dim][/dim]after engine, feedback[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]sheet: add Ctrl+M marking in list and argument stages, the numbered [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sequence tray, Enter and Ctrl+Enter routing with the review card, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Backspace and Esc rules, and the grouped RECENT sequence row that reruns[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]as one unit.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Plugin reference, user guide, and deploy[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]docs[dim] · [dim][/dim]after sheet[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]docs: document sequences in the bob-plugins plugin reference and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bob-cli guide, run the full plugin and docs gates, and deploy with bob [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plugins sync.[/#D7D7AF]
